acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: You cannot fully check this one yourself, because it depends on the outside provider you choose. Ask your builder to show you that provider's terms and settings proving it will not use uploaded audio to train AI models, and when they were checked.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Two parts. (1) Product: deliberately attempt it through the product's own code and its calls to outside services; expected: blocked and recorded. (2) Provider: record which provider was chosen, the contract or data-use terms, and the account settings that rule it out, with the date checked.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When any part of the product itself attempts to use uploaded audio to train AI models, the system shall prevent it.
acceptanceCriteria.verificationCondition: Cannot be marked VERIFIED until the outside provider is chosen and its data-use terms and configuration have been checked and recorded. A test of the product alone does not prove what a provider does with the data.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Try to make this happen on purpose: publish, send or act on AI output without the user's approval. It should not be possible.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Deliberately attempt it — as a user and through any background process or connected service. Expected: it is blocked, nothing is changed or shared, and the attempt is recorded as evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When any user or process attempts to publish, send or act on AI output without the user's approval, the system shall prevent it.

acceptanceCriteria.founderCheck: Check for yourself: Five podcasters use it on a real episode and say they would use it again.
acceptanceCriteria.howToCheck: Record the observed result against this statement: what was measured, by whom, and when.
acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the first version is evaluated, the product owner shall be able to observe that: Five podcasters use it on a real episode and say they would use it again.

intent.aiFailureBehaviour: A person reviews and can edit every AI result before it is used or shared.

coreWorkflow.text: Get a draft of show notes, chapter markers and three social posts
Review and edit the AI's result before it is used or shared
Copy the final text into their podcast host and social accounts

intent.desiredOutcome: Publishing an episode's written material takes under 15 minutes instead of about two hours
intent.integrationFailureBehaviour: Show a clear message and let people try again later.

integrations.text: A speech-to-text and AI writing service — to transcribe the episode and draft the text

intent.jobToBeDone: Turn each finished episode into show notes, chapters and promo posts without spending two hours writing them

mustNot.text: Use uploaded audio to train AI models
Publish, send or act on AI output without the user's approval

outOfScope.text: Posting directly to social media accounts

successCriteria.text: Five podcasters use it on a real episode and say they would use it again
The AI cost of one episode stays under the agreed cost limit

intent.targetUser: Independent podcasters who publish weekly and edit their own shows
